title: Damar Hamlin Joins Under Armour as Brand Ambassador, Championing Mental Wellness for the Next Generation
summary: Damar Hamlin is joining Under Armour as a brand ambassador, bringing his passion for community impact to the brand's continued efforts to support the next generation of athletes. Hamlin will represent the brand as the athlete ambassador for Protect This Mind, UA’s new mental wellness initiative designed to help student-athletes access trusted resources, build stronger support systems and develop skills that support lifelong wellbeing.
body_markdown:
For Damar Hamlin, impact has always extended well beyond the game.


In his sixth season, the NFL professional football athlete is joining Under Armour as a brand ambassador, bringing his passion for community impact to the brand's continued efforts to support the next generation of athletes.


In addition to competing in Under Armour’s cleats and gloves on the field, Hamlin will represent the brand as the athlete ambassador for[Protect This Mind](https://about.underarmour.com/en/stories/2026/11/under-armour-launches--protect-this-mind---a-new-mental-wellness.html) , UA’s new mental wellness initiative designed to help student-athletes access trusted resources, build stronger support systems and develop skills that support lifelong wellbeing. As the public face of Protect This Mind, Hamlin will use his platform and share his own experiences to help young athletes understand the importance of prioritizing mental wellbeing.
